label: Harsh overhead light
interpretation: The room may stay more alert than the goal requires because the highest light source is dominating the mood.
firstMovePrinciples: add a lower and softer light cue first

label: Under-claimed blank zone
interpretation: The room may feel unfinished or lightly suspended because the eye has nowhere gentle to settle in that zone.
firstMovePrinciples: turn blank pressure into a soft landing point

label: Softness deficit
interpretation: The room may read as usable and orderly, but not yet emotionally eased or physically inviting.
firstMovePrinciples: use one low-cost restorative cue before reorganizing everything

label: Visual overlap
interpretation: The room may ask the nervous system to hold more than one state at once.
firstMovePrinciples: remove one competing cue before adding more
